nodes.name: Outpost Zero (Start)
nodes.description: Makeshift evacuation bunker where Aarav and Mira held out until food ran dry.

nodes.name: North Canal Bridge
nodes.description: Quiet pedestrian footbridge with minimal walker activity.

nodes.name: Redoubt Toll Booth
nodes.description: Abandoned highway toll barrier with scattered civilian luggage.

nodes.name: Overlook Warehouse
nodes.description: Logistics hub. Canned rations and heavy battery packs intact on top racks.

nodes.name: Hillside Water Tower
nodes.description: Municipal gravity-fed reservoir with clean filtered groundwater.

nodes.name: Pine Ridge Bunker
nodes.description: Reinforced forest ranger outpost with solar panels and barred steel doors.

nodes.name: Eastern Valley Road
nodes.description: Isolated two-lane asphalt cutting through overgrown pine groves.

nodes.name: Old Church Sanctuary
nodes.description: Stone parish with fortified heavy oak doors and a quiet bell tower.

nodes.name: Quarry Overpass
nodes.description: Narrow concrete bridge overlooking the abandoned granite excavation site.

nodes.name: West Freight Depot
nodes.description: Rusted cargo cars providing excellent cover against open lines of sight.

nodes.name: St. Jude Field Clinic
nodes.description: Urgent triage station overrun during the first week. Emergency medicine lockers intact.

nodes.name: Sawmill Storage
nodes.description: Lumber complex with industrial generator fuel and emergency toolkits.

nodes.name: Southwest Relay Station
nodes.description: Enclosed radio transmitter shed with heavy perimeter chain-link fence.

nodes.name: Marshland Causeway
nodes.description: Elevated boardwalk traversing stagnant murky floodplains.

nodes.name: South Gate Checkpoint
nodes.description: Military barricade with automated turret mounts long drained of power.

nodes.name: Riverside Refinery
nodes.description: Chemical plant loading docks. Still houses heavy-duty lithium power cells.

nodes.name: Metro Central Station
nodes.description: Cracked subterranean plaza echoing with intermittent distant shrieks.

nodes.name: Metro General Hospital
nodes.description: Massive multi-story medical facility. High danger, but packed with surgical trauma kits.

nodes.name: Deadzone Crossroads
nodes.description: Intersection of 4th and Main. Burned out APCs line the center lanes.

nodes.name: Grand Market Ruins
nodes.description: Commercial plaza with collapsed skylights and untouched pantry containers.

nodes.name: Sub-Zero Cold Storage
nodes.description: Commercial refrigeration depot with vacuum-sealed freeze-dried meat rations.

nodes.name: Heart of the Swarm
nodes.description: Ground zero of the secondary outbreak. Dense horde nesting under highway bridge.

nodes.name: Radio Tower 9
nodes.description: Reinforced communications compound with razor wire and generator room.

nodes.name: Downtown Expressway
nodes.description: Elevated bypass choked with gridlocked, decayed vehicles.

nodes.name: Burned District Avenue
nodes.description: Ash-covered corridor through firebombed residential city blocks.

nodes.name: Mercy Children's Ward
nodes.description: Suburban pediatric annex. Preserved sterile supplies in back pharmaceutical vaults.

nodes.name: Transit Hub Alpha
nodes.description: City bus maintenance center with heavy rolling security shutters.

nodes.name: Industrial Zone Gamma
nodes.description: Smokestack factory district littered with scrap metal and fuel tanks.

nodes.name: Power Substation 4
nodes.description: Humming high-voltage transformer yard near the final river crossing.

nodes.name: The Beacon Sanctuary
nodes.description: The fortified survivor colony on the coast. Guard towers, clean water, and salvation.

dangerZones.name: The Swarm Epicenter
dangerZones.description: Massive concentration of fast stalkers and nests centered around the highway collapse.

dangerZones.name: Subterranean Metro Infestation
dangerZones.description: Dark tunnels with poor visibility, echoing shrieks, and toxic spore pockets.

dangerZones.name: Commercial District Quarantine
dangerZones.description: Enclosed glass atriums now harboring mutated nocturnal apex packs.

dangerZones.name: Industrial Hazard Zone
dangerZones.description: Chemical runoffs, compromised cooling towers, and wandering feral squads.

dangerZones.name: Flooded Basin Outskirts
dangerZones.description: Sluggish crawlers trapped in mire and rotting timber structures.
